verdict.rationale: Attio exposes a public JSON-over-HTTPS REST API with filtering and sorting, documented 429/Retry-After rate limiting, and signed webhooks, so automation can drive it without the UI. An official MCP server and an `attio` CLI (shown via `attio migrate`) add further non-UI entry points. missing for 10: CI-specific guidance (pipeline examples, service-account/API-key setup for unattended runs), a CLI documented for headless data operations rather than app development, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration.
